A.rationale: The agent made an on-topic dependency change and regenerated install state, but did not complete the required source migration away from react-router-dom or add the needed test/runtime setup for React Router 7. Its own run still showed migration-related failures such as unresolved react-router-dom imports and missing TextEncoder, and the final verifier reported multiple targeted suites failing. Although the run ended with an AgentTimeoutError, this was after partial edits and verification attempts rather than only planning/no edits.

B.rationale: The agent spent 45 steps repeatedly updating a todo list without making any substantive code changes, then performed a version bump and ran tests. The test run was terminated by a shell timeout after 120 seconds, and the recorded exception is AgentTimeoutError, indicating the agent ran out of time before completing the migration. No candidate patch is available, and the verifier confirms the tests still fail.
